sn1.41:1.1: Evam me sutam ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārame || || Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antam ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn1.41:2.1: Ādittasmim agārasmiṃ || yaṃ nīharati bhājanaṃ || taṃ tassa hoti atthāya || no ca yaṃ tattha ḍayhatīti || ||
sn1.41:3.1: Evam ādīpito loko || jarāya maraṇena ca || nīhareth-eva dānena || dinnaṃ hoti sunīhataṃ || ||
sn1.41:4.1: dinnaṃ sukhaphalaṃ hoti || nādinnam hoti taṃ tathā || corā haranti rājāno || aggī ḍayhati nassati || ||
sn1.41:5.1: Atha antena jahāti || sarīraṃ sapariggahaṃ || etad aññāya medhāvi || bhuñjetha ca dadetha ca || datvā bhutvā ca yathānubhāvaṃ || anindito saggam upeti ṭhānan ti || ||
